summary: Filed the aftermath experiment for the child question @forged_forget_aftermath as a fresh fixed experiment (same harness file, third test function, reached through the public Step/Ready/Advance path): real forgery, real campaign, real grants, then the new leader's first append delivered to the deposed incumbent. While preparing it I found two things that changed the account rather than being smoothed over — in this harness the followers never receive leader 1's term-2 entry, so the incumbent's committed prefix is (index=10, term=1) and the new leader anchors exactly there and is accepted; and the new leader's own commit index did not advance after that acknowledgement, whose operands (per-peer Match) are not fully observable through the public API here, so the value is emitted as raw data with no comparison depending on it. Six comparisons were requested: the under-lease control, the acceptance predicate and the election predicate (expected violated), plus three bounds (incumbent becomes follower at term 3, anchor equals the committed prefix, incumbent follows the new leader). Validation passed with the execution requested; the receipt and its interpretation are still pending.
